one_liner: Senior Forest Service national program manager who writes wildfire prevention planning policy and guides regional and field units on prevention plans, education, and enforcement.
fit_summary: The posting requires prior wildland firefighting experience as a selective placement factor, plus a year of wildfire-prevention experience at GW-12 level, with no education substitute. Daniel's emergency planning and exercise work is relevant to interagency coordination, but his resume has no firefighting, so he would be screened out.
eligibility: Open to the public, including U.S. citizens with no prior federal service, under Direct-Hire Authority; veterans' preference does not apply.
Selective placement factor: prior wildland firefighting experience is required (secondary firefighter retirement position).
Specialized experience: one year equivalent to GW-12 in wildfire prevention program management, planning or assessments, modeling, or program of work and budget. No education substitution is allowed.
Conditions include drug testing, a background check, possibly passing the Work Capacity Test, willingness to live or work in remote locations, and a 1-year probationary period.
strategy: Skip this one: wildland firefighting experience is a hard requirement.
Look at entry-level FEMA, Virginia VDEM or Prince William County emergency management roles instead, where his IEM background fits better.
interview_questions: Describe your wildland firefighting experience and how it informs prevention planning.
How have you coordinated a plan across national, regional, and field-level stakeholders with competing priorities?
How would you evaluate whether a unit's wildfire prevention education and enforcement efforts are effective?
Walk us through how you have built an annual program of work and budget.
watch_outs: Prior wildland firefighting experience is mandatory; your known background does not show it.
The specialized experience must be wildfire-prevention specific at GW-12 level, which general emergency management consulting may not meet.
The Work Capacity Test, remote-location condition, and drug testing may apply, and there is no promotion potential.
